name: Toolboxes
summary: Foundry Toolbox versioned MCP endpoint consumed by a BYOM-routed Prompt Agent via MCPTool.
description: `project.toolboxes.create_version(...)` creates a Toolbox version, and a Prompt Agent can invoke it through an `MCPTool` pointed at the toolbox MCP endpoint. This lets users package tools behind MCP while the agent's orchestrator model remains `{connection}/{deployment}`.
notes:
Verified end-to-end with the current Toolbox-through-MCP pattern. See `test.py`.

Live proof used `project.toolboxes.create_version(tools=[ToolboxSearchPreviewToolboxTool()])` and an `MCPTool` pointed at `{project_endpoint}/toolboxes/{name}/versions/{version}/mcp?api-version=v1` with an AAD bearer; the BYOM-prefixed Prompt Agent invoked `tool_search`. Historical note: SDK 2.2.0 exposed `ToolboxSearchPreviewTool` for direct agent attachment, and that path is rejected under BYOM with `The following tools are not supported with BYO model: toolbox_search_preview`; in SDK 2.3.0 the toolbox is wrapped behind MCP, and MCP is BYOM-supported. Reference sample: https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-python/blob/main/sdk/ai/azure-ai-projects/samples/agents/tools/sample_agent_toolbox_skill.py.
